title: Core Framework Overview
summary: This module provides the foundational components and utilities for building LangChain applications. It defines core abstractions, manages API lifecycle and security, handles callbacks and tracing, and offers general-purpose utilities for various framework operations.

nodes.label: Core Abstractions
nodes.title: Fundamental LangChain Abstractions
nodes.description: Defines the abstract base classes and interfaces for all core LangChain components, including serializable objects, composable runnables, language models, prompts, and tools. It forms the architectural backbone.

nodes.label: API & Security Utilities
nodes.title: API Lifecycle & Security Management
nodes.description: Provides essential utilities for managing API lifecycle (beta features, deprecations) and robust security features, primarily focusing on Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) protection for URL validation.

nodes.label: Callbacks & Tracing
nodes.title: Observability & Event Handling
nodes.description: Offers core functionalities for handling asynchronous and synchronous callbacks, managing execution traces, and dispatching custom events for detailed logging, monitoring, and integration with tracing platforms.

nodes.label: General Utilities
nodes.title: Common Helper Functions & Tools
nodes.description: Contains a collection of fundamental utility functions and classes, including tools for managing data streams, parsing HTML, handling Pydantic models, argument validation, and in-memory caching.

edges.label: Generates events for
edges.title: Event Generation
edges.description: Core components like Runnables emit events that are captured and processed by the callbacks and tracing system for observability.

edges.label: Uses for validation
edges.title: Security Integration
edges.description: Some core abstractions (e.g., tools, models) might leverage security utilities for input validation or safe operations, such as URL checks.

edges.label: Leverages common helpers
edges.title: Utility Dependency
edges.description: Core components often rely on general utilities for tasks like serialization, data manipulation, or environment checks, ensuring efficient operations.

edges.label: Uses for internal tasks
edges.title: Internal Utility Usage
edges.description: The tracing system might use general utilities for tasks like caching trace data, managing internal data structures, or other supporting operations.

edges.label: Reports security events to
edges.title: Security Event Reporting
edges.description: Security utilities can report warnings or incidents (e.g., deprecation warnings, SSRF alerts) to the tracing system for logging and monitoring purposes.

groups.label: Foundational Components
groups.title: Core Architectural Elements
groups.description: These modules establish the fundamental structure, interfaces, and core building blocks upon which all LangChain applications are constructed, defining the basic types and behaviors.

groups.label: Cross-Cutting Concerns
groups.title: System-Wide Support Services
groups.description: These modules provide essential services that span across the entire framework, enabling observability, security, and robust API management for all components, ensuring reliability and maintainability.

groups.label: Supporting Utilities
groups.title: General Purpose Helper Tools
groups.description: This module offers a collection of versatile utility functions and classes that support various operations across the framework, from data handling and parsing to system information and caching.
